crime_highlights: There is no doubt that Mr. Lyde and Mr. Martinez were both present at the home when Mr. Rogers was killed
Both men were polite and respectful to the Court, but refused to testify, even after receiving legal advice
It is very likely both men could have stated who it was that fired that shot.
rationale_highlights: He experienced racism as a native and was often involved in fights.
when I take the Gladue factors into account, I conclude that he should receive the same sentence as Mr. Lyde
note: Contempt for refusing to testify; Gladue applies to Martinez only.

crime_highlights: It is conceded that Mr. Forrest essentially picked up on the situation and saw it as necessary to stop Mr. Regehr from leaving. He struck him.
Mr. Regehr fell to the floor and banged his head.
He was hit several more times and kicked in the groin area.
Mr. Regehr went in and out of consciousness
Eventually they put a hoodie over his head, took him to Mr. Duerksen's truck, and Mr. Duerksen drove them to a nearby park.
rationale_highlights: the abuse and dysfunction to which his grandparents and mother were subjected
I will take into account his aboriginal background as an aspect of his moral blameworthiness in this case
will reflect that when I am considering the fitness of the joint submission
note: Gladue applies to Forrest only; injuries described in paras 12-13.

crime_highlights: Mr. Smith was selling drugs in front of the Carnegie Centre
made the mistake of offering them for sale to a plain-clothes constable of the Vancouver Police Department
13 flaps of fentanyl (approximately 2.6 grams in total)
rationale_highlights: I must consider the unique systemic and background factors which may have played a part in bringing Mr. Smith before the court
there is little evidence that any unique circumstances in Mr. Smith's Aboriginal background might lessen his culpability for the present offence or reduce the effectiveness of any prison sentence
All of these factors, as well as his Aboriginal background and other personal circumstances warrant a sentence at the low end of the range referred to above.
note: Court finds little Gladue link; Aboriginal background only one factor for low end.
